div.head: IV Atr 6
div.ab: Et precipimus, ne quis pecuniam puram et recte appendentem sonet, monetetur in quocumque portu monetetur in regno meo, super ouerhyrnessam meam.
Et praecipimus ne quis pecuniam puram et recte appendentem sonet, monetetur in quocumque portu monetetur in regno meo, super overhirnessam meam.
And we enjoin that no-one shall refuse pure money of the proper weight, in whatever town in my kingdom it be coined, under pain of incurring the fine for insubordination to me.
Und wir gebieten, dass niemand reines und richtig wiegendes Geld zurückweise, sei es geprägt, in welcher Stadt in meinem Reiche es auch geprägt sei, bei [Strafe der Busse für] Ungehorsam gegen mich.
And we command that no one refuse pure money of correct weight, wherever in my kingdom it may have been minted, on [pain of the fine for] disobedience to me.
